transcript.text: I need to share something critical before we proceed. This morning while testing an unrelated CI plugin, I confirmed that exactly 37 of the 100 CI pipeline artifact paths depend on POSIX rename semantics that archive object storage cannot provide. The remaining 63 pipelines can migrate safely. I haven't updated the migration ticket yet, but this directly impacts the draft production plan's assumption that all 100 pipelines can be moved to archive object storage.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to open the compliance finding now. I confirmed with the audit team this morning that release artifacts for regulated products must be retained in immutable storage for exactly 730 days. The draft plan's 90-day deletion policy and unlocked object storage both violate that requirement. This needs to be on the record before we settle on a revised plan.
